title: Messaging — Mux Ack — payload
description: A principal acknowledges frames delivered on the mux connection that carries the request. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

messageIds.description: Ids of frames delivered on this connection that the principal has handled. An id appears at most once.

MessageId.title: Message id
MessageId.description: The lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of a stored message: for a TSP message, of the base64url (no padding) encoding of its qb2 bytes.

AckRefusal.title: Ack refusal
AckRefusal.description: An id the mediator did not delete, and why.

reason.description: `notPermitted`: the message is held for a member this connection carries, which lacks the `delete` scope (or whose account no longer stands); it stays in the member's inbox. `notFound`: anything else — already deleted, expired, never delivered here, or held for a DID the connection does not carry, which is not told apart from a message that does not exist.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Ack — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/ack request: every requested id appears in `acked` or `refused`. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/ack/0.1#response.

refused.description: Ids that were not deleted, each with its reason. Those messages are left as they were.
